about: Live articles from 18 outlets, exported by `gjurme stories-sample` in the Source validation workflow (run 44181361743), entities by the keyword rules. Derived data only (ADR-003): `words` are the excerpt's content words, sorted, never its text.
labels: `event`: the event the article reports; same label = same story. null = no other article in the sample reports it. `a/b` = part b of event a: different parts are related (scored neither way). `related`: other events the article is part of.
